note: PROPOSED drafts — Werner reviews/edits the claims, confirmers, disconfirmers and kill criteria, then sets frozen_at. After freezing, the agent NEVER edits these silently. The 'log' arrays carry two channels: AUTO entries appended mechanically by the nightly job on scheduled-event days (date, event, basket 1d return — no narrative), and MANUAL entries appended by Werner (tagged analyst). Kill-criteria status is computed mechanically from the log, never inferred.

claims.claim: Hyperscaler AI capex sustains datacenter/semis demand growth through 2027; power buildout is the binding constraint.
disconfirmers: inference-cost collapse narrative with order cuts
rate path repricing higher (long-duration multiple compression)
claims.kill_criteria: Two consecutive quarters of aggregate hyperscaler capex guidance cuts, OR thesis basket -30% from peak with confirmed order-cut reporting.

claims.claim: Transaction volumes and net interest economics stay resilient; exchanges/processors compound through the rate cycle with toll-road economics.
disconfirmers: consumer credit deterioration spilling into volumes
claims.kill_criteria: Two consecutive quarters of negative aggregate payment-volume growth, OR thesis basket -25% from peak alongside credit-loss provisioning spikes at the brokers.

claims.claim: Structural underinvestment in energy and gold supply plus fiscal dominance keeps real-asset cash flows and royalty streams bid.
disconfirmers: sustained supply response (shale or OPEC spare capacity)
claims.kill_criteria: WTI below $50 for a quarter with rig counts RISING, OR thesis basket -30% from peak.

claims.claim: Staples/health quality compounds with low beta; holds value in drawdowns and funds redeployment at regime turns.
claims.kill_criteria: Basket FAILS its defensive function: declines more than SPY in two consecutive 5%+ SPY drawdowns.

claims.claim: Vertical-software moats (life sciences, creative, SMB finance) keep pricing power and net retention independent of the AI capex cycle.
claims.kill_criteria: Two consecutive quarters of aggregate net-retention below 100%, OR thesis basket -35% from peak with churn-driven guidance cuts.

claims.claim: Services/experiences spending stays prioritized over goods; travel and luxury demand survives a mild slowdown.
claims.kill_criteria: Two consecutive quarters of negative aggregate bookings growth, OR unemployment +1pp from cycle low (Sahm-rule trigger) while basket is -20% from peak.
